name: Spreadsheet Viewer
description: Open xlsx / xlsm / xlsb / xls / ods workbooks, switch sheets, then sort, search, filter and export
help: Supports xlsx, xlsm, xlsb, xls and ods up to 64 MB. The workbook is parsed by Rust and kept locally; the front end reads it page by page and scrolls smoothly.
Merged cells show their value in the top-left cell; formulas display their calculated results; dates and times are converted to readable text automatically.
Click a sheet tab to switch. Click a column header to sort. Open a column's details to see statistics and its most frequent values, and to add filters.
Export the current sheet's view, sorted and filtered, as CSV, TSV, JSON or a Markdown table.
